body: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy CHARACTER CUTOUT atlas. Arcane Vanguard clean cel-shaded painted fantasy, dark contours, restrained material detail. Iron Clan Sapper: compact human engineer with round cyan protective goggles, brown leather workcap, tan and brown padded work jacket, leather tool belt, reinforced trousers, sturdy boots and short leather back apron. Explosives and tools are separate, not on the body. Exact portrait1024x1536 layout: SIXcolumns TWELVErows. Every column is a different true facing: E,rightprofile; SE,frontright; SW,frontLEFT; W,leftprofile; NW,rearleft; NE,rearRIGHT with back of head visible. 72 SEPARATE parts. Rows top to bottom HEAD, torso without head or arms, rear mantle/cape, pelvis/belt, left upperarm, right upperarm, left forearm withhand, right forearm withhand, leftleg withoutboot, rightleg withoutboot, leftboot, rightboot. Neutral straight parts. Generous empty gap between all pieces; heads MUST NOT touch torsos, no limbs attached to torsos. No assembled character, weapons, text, labels, grid, scenery, background or shadows. Truly alpha-transparent background.
equipment: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy Iron Clan equipment cutouts, clean celshaded painted art with crisp contours, brass/iron/wood materials. TWO ROWS six columns: row1 small red dynamite bundle with short unlit fuse and cloth wrapping; row2 small steel demolition hammer on wooden handle pointingUP. Six true orientations E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE each row, twelve isolated objects. No hands. Landscape1536x1024, exactequalcolumns, alpha-zero gaps, no background, no shadows, no labels, no frames.
effects: Use case stylized-concept. Production transparent 2D fantasy visual effect sheet for sapper. Clean celshaded painted style. Exact6columns4rows, every row6 successiveframes. Four rows six animationframes each: thrown red dynamite bundle pointingright with short spark tail; orange demolition explosion expanding then dissipating; dusty arrival cloud; sharp stone fracture sparks. Landscape1536x1024. Eachframecentered insideequalcell with largeemptytransparentmargins. No words, grids, background or backdropglow.
